description: This file defines a console command class, ResetInstallationCommand, for the OrangeHRM system. The command resets the system installation by dropping the main and test databases, removing configuration and key files, and providing status updates via CLI.

classes.name: ResetInstallationCommand
classes.description: A CLI command class that resets the OrangeHRM system installation by dropping existing databases and deleting configuration files, implementing the Symfony Console Command interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the command description, indicating its purpose to reset the OrangeHRM installation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main logic for executing the reset operation: checks installation status, drops databases, deletes configuration files, handles exceptions, and outputs status messages.
